title: 第52章 宴席风波上第53章 家宴风波中
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
蔡芸带着赵宇一直往蔡家内院走去，一路上赵宇看着蔡家院内布置倒颇有特色，闹中有静，静中又透出活力，院落错落有致，还显出山水自然本色，赏心悦目。
蔡芸一直把他带到一个很幽静的院落，院中有花有草、有山有水，非常别致。
进了院子，蔡芸就对赵宇说道：“赵公子，你看这如何？要是可以，这几天就委屈赵公子住在这里了。
若不满意，我再给赵公子另换。”
赵宇本就随意之人，这两年还天天与野兽为伍，这样的院子还有什么不满意的？便回答道：“不错，很好！”
心想这段时间也确实没有好好休息，静下心来休息休息，修炼修炼，甚是满意。
蔡家安排好几个佣人来服待赵宇，赵宇本想回绝，又一想这也是那些大户人家的排场，只要不影响自己休息、修炼即可。
蔡芸安排好一切，也就马上回她住的地方了，这些日子她都没好好地洗过澡了，还不得回去好好地给自己“过过堂”
赵宇痛痛快快洗了澡，坐下来休息一会想修炼一下，可一会儿就睡着了，这一觉他睡得真香，等他被蔡芸叫醒时天都黑了。
实在是蔡芸早就过来了，在外面等了好一会看赵宇还是没个动静，内心难免焦急，怕去太晚了，被族中长辈看成傲慢无礼就不好了，蔡芸的心里自然而然把赵宇看成是自己的什么人。
赵宇醒来一看也觉得大事不好，既然答应别人赴宴，又去晚了那就太失礼了。
他慌慌忙忙地穿上外套就想蔡芸去赴宴，可连个衣服都没穿戴整齐，蔡芸平时穿衣打扮都需要小玉待候着，这次只能自己上阵了，两人一阵的手忙脚乱终于算是齐活了，才急匆匆地赶往家族大厅。
一到大厅，果然蔡家所有人早就等候多时，若不是今日有老祖在场，又经过蔡忠蔡白及一干护卫的“宣传”
，再加上赵宇是天雷宗金牌弟子，估计底下早吵吵开了，蔡家今日宴会还真是很隆重，不但有老祖到场，族中高层，还有那些主要的女眷，最后家族重要的主要培养的子弟都有参加，毕竟赵宇也是少年。
赵宇一入场，众人的眼光齐刷刷盯了过来，赵宇感觉好似万箭穿心，开始时就觉得不就是吃顿饭吗？至于搞成这样，这次他真感到慌了。
就在此时脑海中传来了小忠的传音，他知道这是赵宇平生第一次碰到这样的场面，难免怯场！
所以必须鼓劲：“小主，别紧张，你把那些人看成最普通的东西不就行了？你现在连四阶妖兽都能干掉，这些人又算什么，他家的老祖也不过是超凡境四重而已，若让你砍，不就二剑就解决了，以后别说这种场面，比这大百倍、千倍的场面都会有，这点算什么？你以后是要纵横诸天的存在……”
听着小忠的鼓励，赵宇渐渐地定下心来，想想也是！
这点场面都驾驭不住，那还混个屁啊！
再说这些人又不是自己的对手，胆气一壮，发红的脸渐趋正常。

蔡芸反而有些慌张着急了，忙对着老祖一干人解释道：“老祖，赵公子因为修炼忘了时间了，望老祖别怪罪！”
她为了给赵宇开脱，只好说谎了。
想不到老祖不但没有怪罪，反而夸了一句：”
毕竟大宗子弟，每时每刻都想修炼，难怪如此年轻，有那么高的成就。”
content_en:
Cai Yun led Zhao Yu to the inner courtyard of the Cai family. Along the way, Zhao Yu saw that the layout of the Cai family's courtyard was quite unique. There was tranquility in the bustle, and vitality in the quietness. The courtyards were well-proportioned and showed the natural nature of the mountains and rivers, which was pleasing to the eye.
Cai Yun took him to a very quiet courtyard. There were flowers, grass, mountains and water in the courtyard, which was very unique.
After entering the courtyard, Cai Yun said to Zhao Yu: "Mr. Zhao, what do you think of this? If possible, I would have wronged Mr. Zhao to live here these days.
If you are not satisfied, I will give Mr. Zhao another replacement. "
Zhao Yu is a casual person, but he has been with wild animals every day for the past two years. What else can he be dissatisfied with in such a yard? He replied: "Yes, very good!"
I thought to myself that I really hadn’t had a good rest during this period, so I calmed down to rest, practice, and practice, and I was very satisfied.
The Cai family arranged several servants to serve Zhao Yu. Zhao Yu originally wanted to refuse, but then he thought that this was also the pomp of those wealthy families, as long as it did not affect his rest and cultivation.
After Cai Yun arranged everything, she immediately went back to her place of residence. She hadn't taken a proper bath these days, and she had to go back to "examine" herself properly.
Zhao Yu took a quick bath, sat down to rest for a while and wanted to practice, but fell asleep after a while. He slept so soundly, and it was already dark when he was woken up by Cai Yun.
In fact, Cai Yun had come here a long time ago. After waiting outside for a long time, there was still no movement from Zhao Yu. She was inevitably anxious, fearing that if she left too late, she would be seen as arrogant and rude by the elders of the clan. Cai Yun naturally regarded Zhao Yu as someone of her own.
When Zhao Yu woke up, he felt that something was wrong. Since he agreed to attend the banquet, it would be rude to arrive late.
He hurriedly put on his coat and wanted Cai Yun to go to the banquet, but he didn't even have his clothes neatly dressed. Cai Yun usually had to wait for Xiaoyu to get dressed, but this time she had to go into battle by herself. After a period of confusion, the two finally got together and hurried to the family hall.
As soon as they arrived at the hall, everyone in the Cai family had been waiting for a long time. If it hadn't been for the presence of the ancestors today and the "propaganda" of Cai Zhong, Cai Bai and a group of guards,
, plus Zhao Yu is a gold medal disciple of Tianlei Sect, it is estimated that the quarrel has already started. Today's banquet of the Cai family is really grand. Not only the ancestors are present, but also the senior members of the clan, the main female relatives, and finally the important and main disciples of the family are also present. After all, Zhao Yu is also a young man.
As soon as Zhao Yu entered the scene, everyone's eyes were fixed on him. Zhao Yu felt as if a thousand arrows had penetrated his heart. From the beginning, he felt that it was just a meal. As for what happened, he was really panicked this time.
At this moment, Xiao Zhong's message came to his mind. He knew that this was the first time in Zhao Yu's life that he had encountered such a scene, and it was inevitable that he would have stage fright!
So I must encourage: "Little Master, don't be nervous, just treat those people as the most ordinary things? You can even kill the fourth-level monsters now, so what do these people mean? His ancestor is only the fourth-level transcendent realm. If you kill him, he can be solved with two swords. Don't talk about this kind of scene in the future. There will be scenes a hundred or a thousand times bigger than this. What does this mean? You will be an existence that controls the heavens in the future..."
Listening to Xiao Zhong's encouragement, Zhao Yu gradually calmed down, thinking about it!
If you can't control this situation, then you're still messing around!
Besides, these people were no match for him, so he became more courageous and his red face gradually became normal.
Cai Yun was a little flustered and anxious, and hurriedly explained to the ancestors and the others: "Ancestor, Mr. Zhao has lost track of time because of his practice. I hope you won't blame me!"
In order to excuse Zhao Yu, she had no choice but to lie.
Unexpectedly, instead of blaming me, my ancestor praised me: "
After all, most of the disciples want to practice every moment. No wonder they are so young and have such high achievements. "
